issue.title: [bug] OpenHarmony app shows white screen when it's initialized by `cargo tauri ohos init`
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When building a Tauri application for OpenHarmony initialized with`cargo tauri ohos init`, the app shows a white screen after launch. This is caused by compatibility issues with the previous version of `@ohos-rs/ability`.

- Platform:
  - Tauri version: latest (in branch feat/open-harmony)
  - HarmonyOS/OpenHarmony version: 6.0

This is the screenshot of this bug.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/67d38ad9-c110-4b4f-aaec-f0a8a12d5a3f)


### Reproduction

1. Init and build a HarmonyOS tauri project
```bash
cargo install tauri-cli --git https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri --branch feat/open-harmony
cargo install ohrs
cargo install create-tauri-app --locked
cargo create-tauri-app
cargo tauri ohos init
npm i
cargo tauri ohos build
```
2. Install the .hap application to the HarmonyOS Device
3. Open the application，then the blank white screen will be the only thing you can see in the application's window.

### Expected behavior

The webview should render correctly and show the Tauri app content.

### Full `tauri info` output

```text

    ✔ cargo: 1.96.0-nightly (888f67534 2026-03-30)
    ✔ rustup: 1.28.1 (f9edccde0 2025-03-05)
    ✔ Rust toolchain: nightly-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (overridden by environment variable RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN)
    - node: 25.8.1
    - pnpm: 9.15.2
    - npm: 11.11.0
    - bun: 1.1.26
    - deno: deno 2.7.11

[-] Packages
    - tauri 🦀: 2.8.5, (outdated, latest: 2.10.3)
    - tauri-build 🦀: 2.4.1, (outdated, latest: 2.5.6)
    - wry 🦀: git+https://github.com/richerfu/wry#3b3762817ec6d9b84db594cf11bb6dc3b95d3244 (0.53.3), (outdated, latest: 0.55.0)       
    - tao 🦀: git+https://github.com/richerfu/tao?branch=feat-ohos-webview#fd7ce5c8dcc02df3f5a955eec317db62cbe5ea46 (0.34.3), (outdated, latest: 0.35.0)
    - tauri-cli 🦀: 2.8.4 (outdated, latest: 2.10.1)
    - @tauri-apps/api : not installed!

[-] Plugins
    - tauri-plugin-log 🦀: 2.6.0, (outdated, latest: 2.8.0)
    - @tauri-apps/plugin-log : not installed!

[-] App
    - build-type: bundle
    - CSP: default-src 'self' customprotocol: asset:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; style-src 'unsafe-inline' 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:
```

### Stack trace

```text

```

### Additional context

The issue is resolved by bumping `@ohos-rs/ability` from 0.2.1 to 0.4.0-beta.0. Verified on my HarmonyOS PC.

Test repository: https://github.com/Islatri/tauri-ohos-test

And I created a PR to solve this issue in PR #15237 .
